source.what: Community measurement of the attack power the game shows in the armament panel: 310 armaments x 8 Nightfarers, no relics, each armament at its own rarity.
source.sheet: Nightreign Weapon Scaling.xlsx, sheet "Weapon Attack Power", supplied by the App Designer
source.levels: Level 12 for every Nightfarer except the Guardian, whose column stands on level 11: 265 of 271 armaments fit that level and 2 fit level 12 (QA-098). The game states the attributes for levels 1, 2, 12 and 15 only, so the four Guardian rows here stand on **interpolated** attributes while the other nineteen stand on stated ones.
left_out: The Duchess column: it is mixed block by block between levels 11 and 12 and is not usable as a source at all (QA-098).
Staves and seals: the game shows the spell scaling for them, not an attack rating, so the factor does not describe them (QA-099).
Greataxes and great hammers for the Raider: the sheet reads x1.18 above the program there and nobody has found the cause (QA-096).
Revenant's Cursed Claws: the sheet reads x0.88 below the program for every Nightfarer but the owner (QA-097).
source.how_these_rows_were_picked: Nine armaments that scale off no attribute -- they pin the factor without a curve in the way -- and then, for each Nightfarer in the sheet's own column order, the next representative of a weapon class that no earlier row has used, walking the sheet from the top. Two rounds, so two armaments per Nightfarer in fourteen different classes.
source.not_a_selection_of_the_hits: Over the whole sheet with the exclusions above applied, floor(0.6 x rate) reproduces 1900 of 1942 readings exactly (97.8 %). Six of the seven columns miss exactly one armament -- Sword of Night and Flame, the only one with three damage types and two curve ids -- and Ironeye misses one more. The Guardian column misses 35 of 281, 30 of them by exactly 1 low, so a Guardian row here is weaker evidence than the other six. Measured 2026-09-03 for T-045.
